units.source: Split view is a feature of __TRILIUM_PH_0__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_1__ and __TRILIUM_PH_2__Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_3__ notes which displays both the source code on one side and the preview of the content on the other.
__TRILIUM_PH_0__Mermaid Diagrams__TRILIUM_PH_1__ also allow changing between a horizontal or a vertical split, to accommodate for the various sizes of diagrams.

units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: The split comes with three different display modes which can be toggled from the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Note buttons__TRILIUM_PH_1__ area:
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(Split view)__TRILIUM_PH_2__, in which both the source code is available on one side and can be edited, and the preview is available on the other side.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: In this mode, the size of either the source pane or the preview pane can be adjusted by dragging the small border between them.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ (__TRILIUM_PH_1__Source view)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ which shows the source code on the entire screen for a more focused editing experience.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ __TRILIUM_PH_1__(Preview)__TRILIUM_PH_2__ which displays only the rendering of the diagram or text in full screen, especially useful for read-only notes.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: The display node is stored at note level.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction

units.source: A Markdown note included in a text note, or a Markdown file embedded in one, has the same three display modes, switched from the title row and the toolbar of the include. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Included Markdown__TRILIUM_PH_1__ in __TRILIUM_PH_2__Include Note__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: Note types with split view > Display modes and interaction
Note types with split view > Relation to read-only notes

units.source: If a note is marked as __TRILIUM_PH_0__read-only__TRILIUM_PH_1__, the source view will not be editable. While in preview mode, marking a note as read-only has no effect since the preview itself is not editable.
units.context: Note types with split view > Relation to read-only notes
